metadata.title: Comprehensive Statistical Meta-Analysis of 10 Educational Research Studies
metadata.scope: FROZEN SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE POLICY BENCHMARK (7,200 SCENARIOS, 36,000 EXECUTIONS) + 10 HOLDOUTS (1,200 SCENARIOS)
metadata.aggregation_methodology_note: Unstandardized raw differences are NOT averaged across studies because metric units vary (rates vs counts per route). Only scale-free standardized effect sizes (Cliff's delta) and study-specific effects are reported.

meta_summary.cross_study_aggregation_note: Averaging raw unstandardized differences across incompatible metric units (rates vs counts) is deliberately omitted to preserve scientific validity. See study-specific comparisons below.
